problem.title: Valid Palindrome
problem.statement: Determine if a string reads the same forwards and backwards (palindrome). Uppercase and lowercase are considered the same, and non-alphanumeric characters (spaces, punctuation) are ignored.
problem.hint: Start from both ends of the string, then move inward. If you encounter a space or punctuation, skip it before comparing. Try the example: A man a plan a canal Panama - is it a palindrome?
problem.walkthrough:
Try with A man, a plan, a canal, Panama.

Rewrite without spaces/punctuation: amanaplanacanalpanama.

Now place two fingers: one at the start (a), one at the end (a). Match? Move inward.
Second: m and m. Match. Move again.
Keep going until both fingers meet in the middle. No differences? It is a palindrome.

The trick: you do not need to reverse the whole string. Just compare pairs from outside in. If all match, it is a palindrome. If even one differs, stop immediately.
